releaseNotes: v5.1.11 - Silent-helper fix: the v5.1.9 updater helper went completely silent on Sir's PC twice (app handed over, helper never wrote a line). Fixed: the app now launches updater.bat, which writes its own lines to the update log before and after PowerShell, so a dead PowerShell can no longer fail silently; the update details travel in one update-pending.json file instead of a long command line; updater.ps1 is now pure ASCII (Windows PowerShell 5.1 mis-reads BOM-less UTF-8); the spawn has a real error listener; and the Updates page warns on the next launch if a helper was handed an update but never reported in. The helper still waits for the app to fully close, re-checks the SHA-256, installs silently, verifies the installed version, and relaunches. Everything from v5.1.10 unchanged.
